EDC Coffee & Tea is a brand that delivers organic, fair-trade coffee and tea, roasted and blended in small batches.

We also sell a variety of gear and accessories (for brewing, for “everyday carry” use), the EDC Brew Kit (MSRP $140) is first of its kind for brewing Anytime. Anywhere.

The company is veteran-owned & operated. We give back 2% of every order supports the Tunnel to Towers Foundation

☕ Fuel Up. Earn Big. Join the EDC Coffee & Tea Affiliate Program.

Turn your community’s daily coffee habit into real income.

☕ Earn 20% Commission on all new customer orders, then 10% Commission on every additional sale through your unique link or coupon code.

💰 Tiered Bonuses up to $5,000 for top performers.

🎁 Exclusive EDC Gifts for our highest earners.

Example:
Refer 25 customers who each spend $40 or more and earn $275—fast.

Your hustle. Your network. Your fuel.
Unlimited potential. Real rewards. Everyday Coffee & Tea Energy.

We are looking for you to use your networks and tools to get EDC Coffee & Tea in front of as many people as possible. We have included YouTube video deck along with promotional pictures to use.

If you have any questions, you can send us an email at affiliateteam@edcbrew.com

We look forward to working with you!

The EDC Team

EDC Coffee & Tea Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Effective Date: 10.30.2025
Last Updated: 10.30.2025

Welcome to the EDC Coffee & Tea Affiliate Program (“Program”).
These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern your participation in the Program and form a binding agreement between you (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”) and EDC Coffee & Tea LLC (“EDC,” “we,” “our,” or “us”).


By applying to or participating in the Program, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms.

1. Program Overview

The EDC Coffee & Tea Affiliate Program allows approved affiliates to promote our products and earn commissions for qualifying sales made through unique referral links. Participation is free and open to individuals and entities who align with EDC’s mission and values.

2. Eligibility

To participate, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old.

  • Maintain an active, authentic online presence (e.g., social media, website, or community).

  • Not operate or promote content that includes hate speech, illegal activities, adult content, or material inconsistent with the EDC brand and mission.
    EDC reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion.

3. Affiliate Account

Once approved, you’ll gain access to your affiliate dashboard, referral links, and promotional materials.
You are responsible for:

  • Maintaining accurate contact and payment information.

  • Keeping your affiliate credentials secure.

  • Ensuring all promotional activity complies with these Terms and applicable laws.

4. Commission Structure

  • Base Commission: Affiliates earn a percentage (as defined on the Program page) of the net sale amount for qualifying purchases made through their referral link.

  • Bonus Tiers: May be offered at EDC’s discretion.

  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly, typically within 30 days of month-end.

  • Refunds and Chargebacks: Commissions are not paid on refunded, canceled, or fraudulent transactions.

5. Affiliate Responsibilities

You agree to:

  • Represent EDC Coffee & Tea honestly and accurately.

  • Use only approved links, logos, and media provided by EDC.

  • Avoid misleading, deceptive, or spam-based marketing practices.

  • Comply with all applicable laws, including the FTC’s Endorsement Guidelines, requiring clear disclosure of affiliate relationships (e.g., “As an EDC affiliate, I earn from qualifying purchases.”).

6. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates may not:

  • Use unauthorized paid advertising that includes EDC trademarks or domain names (e.g., “edcbrew.com” in Google Ads).

  • Use cookie stuffing, bots, or automated systems to generate traffic or sales.

  • Misrepresent EDC products or pricing.

  • Create or use websites or social channels that impersonate EDC Coffee & Tea.

  • Post discount codes or affiliate links on coupon or rebate sites without written approval.

Any violation of this section may result in immediate termination and forfeiture of commissions.

7. Intellectual Property

All EDC Coffee & Tea trademarks, images, videos, and content are owned by EDC Coffee & Tea LLC and provided solely for use under this Program.
Affiliates are granted a non-exclusive, revocable license to use these materials for promotion under these Terms.


All rights not expressly granted are reserved by EDC.

8. Term and Termination

  • Either party may terminate participation in the Program at any time, with or without cause, by providing written notice.

  • Upon termination, you must immediately remove all EDC links, content, and materials from your platforms.

  • Any outstanding, valid commissions earned before termination will be paid in the next cycle.

EDC reserves the right to terminate or suspend your account for any violation of these Terms or for activity deemed harmful to the brand.

9. Limitation of Liability

EDC Coffee & Tea LLC will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the Program.

Our total liability for any claim relating to the Program shall not exceed the total commissions paid to you during the 3 months preceding the claim.

10. Independent Contractor Relationship

Affiliates are independent contractors and not employees, agents, or partners of EDC Coffee & Tea.You are responsible for your own taxes, insurance, and compliance with applicable laws.

11. Modification of Terms

EDC Coffee & Tea reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time.
Changes will be posted on edcbrew.com with a revised “Last Updated” date.
Continued participation after modifications constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

12. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia, without regard to conflict of law principles.
Any disputes shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Virginia Beach, VA.

13. Contact

For questions or support regarding the affiliate program:

Email: affiliateteam@edcbrew.com
Website: https://edcbrew.com
